title: Reverse Bits
keyIdea: 32 times: shift ans left, copy n's lowest bit into ans's lowest bit, shift n right. The bit taken first ends up leftmost, so the bits come out reversed.

approaches.name: Shift and build
approaches.idea: I wrote this one (you didn't paste code): ans = (ans << 1) | (n & 1); n >>= 1; 32 times.

quiz.q: Why loop all 32 times even if n is small?
options: Leading zeros of n become trailing zeros of the answer
Makes room on the right of ans and puts n's lowest bit there

steps: Brute force: to a 32-char string, reverse, parse. Cost?
"Reverse / rebuild bits" → shift one out, shift one in.
Time and space? Follow-up: cache bytes.
